okdisp AS (SELECT DISTINCT dm.doc_id AS doc_id, dp.code AS code, mm.label AS wg_meeting FROM disposition dp JOIN docmap dm ON dm.k = dp.target JOIN resolution r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id JOIN meetmap mm ON mm.k = r.meeting_id WHERE lower(replace(replace(replace(trim(dp.evidence_status),'_',''),' ',''),'-','')) IN ('sourceverified','verifiedsource') AND lower(replace(replace(replace(trim(dp.scope),'_',''),' ',''),'-','')) IN ('wholedocument','document','whole','fulldocument','entiredocument','doc','wholedoc','tdoc','wholetdoc','full') AND (upper(replace(replace(replace(trim(COALESCE(mm.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','')) IN ('RAN2','R2','RANWG2','TSGRANWG2','WG2','TSGR2','RWG2') OR upper(replace(replace(replace(trim(COALESCE(mm.wg,'')),' ',''),'_',''),'-','')) LIKE 'RAN2%')),
P AS (SELECT id, tsg_number FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number = 'RP-241549' OR id = 'RP-241549'),
pcr AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.id AS doc_id, d.num AS num, d.rel AS rel, P.tsg_number AS ptsg FROM P JOIN inpack ip ON ip.pack_id = P.id JOIN docs d ON d.id = ip.doc_id WHERE d.id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM okdisp) AND d.rel IN ('16','17','18')),
pcl AS (SELECT DISTINCT pc.num AS document, s.spec AS spec, s.rel AS rel, s.clause AS clause, pc.ptsg AS ptsg FROM pcr pc JOIN mods mo ON mo.doc_id = pc.doc_id JOIN sec s ON s.id = mo.section_id WHERE s.rel = pc.rel),
cand AS (SELECT DISTINCT pc.spec AS spec, pc.rel AS rel, pc.clause AS clause, pc.ptsg AS ptsg, cp.id AS pack_id, cp.tsg_number AS tsg FROM (SELECT DISTINCT spec, rel, clause, ptsg FROM pcl) pc JOIN sec s2 ON s2.spec = pc.spec AND s2.rel = pc.rel AND s2.clause = pc.clause JOIN mods mo ON mo.section_id = s2.id JOIN docs d2 ON d2.id = mo.doc_id AND d2.rel = pc.rel JOIN inpack ip ON ip.doc_id = d2.id JOIN cr_pack cp ON cp.id = ip.pack_id WHERE cp.tsg_number < pc.ptsg),
best AS (SELECT spec, rel, clause, ptsg, MAX(tsg) AS mx FROM cand GROUP BY spec, rel, clause, ptsg)
SELECT DISTINCT c.spec AS specification, c.clause AS clause, COALESCE(cp.pack_number, cp.id) AS cr_pack, cp.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
FROM cand c JOIN best b ON b.spec = c.spec AND b.rel = c.rel AND b.clause = c.clause AND b.ptsg = c.ptsg AND c.tsg = b.mx
JOIN cr_pack cp ON cp.id = c.pack_id
